A ticker-by-ticker check of the 10 Moomoo panel representatives produced three confirmations, three potential reversals and four divergences or unavailable prints. Local A/H price and volume take precedence: Shandong Gold remains strong, gold breadth cooled overnight, and Kuaishou weakened sharply after earnings.
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
阿联酋暂停对伊朗贸易，霍尔木兹能源尾险再升
美联社8月19日报道，阿联酋在称再遭伊朗导弹袭击后暂停与伊朗全部贸易；战前阿联酋占伊朗进口逾30%，且近两周已有多艘阿联酋油轮在海峡受袭。事实层面继续支撑油价与上游能源，利空航运、航空和高估值成长。
国际
美加接近贸易协议，50%关税威胁暂缓
美联社称美加接近敲定贸易协议，原定50%的美国关税有望避免，但关键条款仍未完全明确。风险偏好边际改善，工业、汽车和大宗供应链得到喘息；若谈判反复，外需与人民币敏感资产仍会承压。
科技
Moomoo行业全榜揭示贵金属领涨、硬件承压
新任务会话成功抓取Moomoo美股行业榜全部145个行业：白银涨10.98%、黄金涨9.23%、焦煤涨8.65%、贵金属与采矿涨8.39%，而半导体设备与材料跌4.16%、计算机硬件跌5.16%。A/H优先映射黄金、贵金属与焦煤，科技硬件仍看低开承接。
科技
Marvell上涨9.85%，Google定制芯片合作重塑ASIC竞争
Marvell宣布覆盖AI推理加速、网络、存储和近存计算的Google合作，并向Google授予最多5897万股认股权证；股价涨9.85%，Broadcom反跌4.61%。A/H正映射在高速互连、CPO和定制算力，验证信号是中际旭创、海光信息能否强于芯片指数。
科技
韩国KOSPI下跌5.8%，亚洲存储与AI硬件拥挤度暴露
美联社确认韩国KOSPI下跌5.8%、日经225下跌3.2%，反映以三星电子和SK海力士为核心的AI/存储拥挤交易仍在出清。A股存储、设备和服务器链不宜仅因美股指数反弹追高，需看外盘止跌与北向/机构成交。
科技
癌症疫苗三期事件带动医药科技逆势爆发
Moderna与Merck公布黑色素瘤研究积极初步结果，Moderna上涨177%、Merck上涨12.6%。这不是A/H同类公司业绩，但对创新药、mRNA和临床里程碑交易形成情绪映射；A/H仅关注有真实管线与数据披露的公司，避免概念追涨。
财报
小米二季度环比修复，今日再涨约3.50%延续正反馈
小米官方披露二季度营收1089.22亿元，同比下降6.1%、环比增长9.9%；调整后净利62.19亿元，同比下降42.6%、环比增长2.4%。01810.HK在11:17 CST报28.40港元，较昨收27.44港元涨约3.50%，价格继续认可环比改善，仍需验证利润率。
财报
港交所纪录业绩获温和正反馈
港交所官方披露上半年收入及其他收益167.02亿港元，同比增长19%；归母利润105.68亿港元，同比增长24%；每股盈利8.36港元、每股中期息7.43港元。00388.HK在11:17 CST报415.60港元，较昨收414.60港元涨约0.24%，成交反馈偏正但不强。
财报
快手营收略超预期但价格反馈转弱
Futu财报日历显示快手二季度营收355.35亿元，略高于预期354.90亿元；EBIT为37.57亿元，略低于预期38.04亿元。01024.HK在11:17 CST报33.42港元，较昨收37.80港元跌约11.59%，按风险与观察处理，不纳入多头推荐。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
夜盘指数：三大ETF代理温和转正，纳指代理领先
Futu OpenD实时订阅于2026-08-20 11:17 CST（约08/19 23:17 EDT）显示：QQQ（纳指100代理）+0.407%、SPY（标普500代理）+0.118%、DIA（道指代理）+0.041%。这些是夜盘ETF代理而非指数期货；源未标示延迟，API未单列逐笔时间。
板块对照
板块对照：黄金和生物科技潜在反转，硬件压力内部背离
逐项复核panel代表股：EXK +0.090%、HL +0.243%、DQ -0.071%为确认；HYMC -0.035%、MRNA -5.476%、BTCT +113.935%为潜在反转（BTCT个股事件性强，不代表硬件行业普遍反转）；AMR、MLAB、REFR、PASW不可得/无成交，归为背离且无法确认。总体是3项确认、3项潜在反转、4项背离/不可得。
A/H映射
A/H映射：指数偏多但黄金广度降温，优先相信本地量价
温和转正的QQQ/SPY/DIA代理有利于A/H风险偏好，但HYMC与MRNA夜盘反向、四只代表股无成交，说明隔夜强势并未全面确认。运行时山东黄金涨约8.21%、小米涨约3.50%，而快手跌约11.59%；短线以本地成交为主，山东黄金若守住25.36港元开盘价则贵金属映射有效，跌回23.88港元昨收或QQQ转负则失效。

盘前结论

Moomoo现金行业榜中的硬件压力尚未解除：10只代表股夜盘仅DQ延续负向确认，BTCT虽大涨却属个股事件性潜在反转，另有四只无成交，不能据此判断科技硬件全面反转。QQQ、SPY、DIA三只夜盘ETF代理均温和上涨，叠加山东黄金运行时涨约8.21%、小米涨约3.50%，支持A/H选择性风险偏好。

板块对照为3项确认、3项潜在反转、4项背离/不可得，短线应优先相信A/H本地量价：贵金属看山东黄金能否守住25.36港元开盘价，成长链则需QQQ保持正值并等待CPO与国产算力放量确认。

快手跌约11.59%、金山软件跌约3.83%，而金山云涨约8.01%，显示港股科技财报继续分化。若QQQ转负、山东黄金跌回23.88港元昨收，或MRNA夜盘反转向创新药扩散，则降低进攻仓位；否则维持资源与业绩兑现方向的选择性配置。

重点个股推荐

小米集团
01810.HK
业绩正反馈

推荐理由：二季度营收与调整后净利均环比改善，汽车、AI及新业务收入同比增长17.1%，次日股价涨约6.95%。

触发因素：若开盘后守住27港元附近并继续强于恒生科技，可确认资金认可环比修复。

风险点：收入和调整后净利同比仍降6.1%和42.6%，新业务经营亏损26亿元，追高需防利润率再定价。

香港交易所
00388.HK
纪录业绩验证

推荐理由：上半年收入及利润创纪录，归母利润同比增长24%，中期息同比提升至7.43港元。

触发因素：若00388.HK高开后成交放大且不回补大部分缺口，可确认本地金融权重正反馈。

风险点：部分投资收益含非经常性估值收益，若市场成交回落，利润弹性可能被下修。

中际旭创
300308.SZ
CPO订单映射

推荐理由：Marvell与Google合作覆盖AI推理、网络和存储，高速互连是A股最直接的正向映射之一。

触发因素：低开后成交缩量、收复开盘缺口并强于通信设备指数，才视为资金承接。

风险点：SOXX、Broadcom与设备股普跌，若AI资本开支估值继续下修，CPO难以独立走强。

海光信息
688041.SH
国产算力分化

推荐理由：Google扩大定制芯片伙伴说明ASIC需求仍强，国产算力具供应链独立与本地订单逻辑。

触发因素：科创芯片止跌、海光放量强于寒武纪与中芯国际，并获得订单或政策验证。

风险点：Broadcom、AMD、Lam Research同步下跌说明行业估值压缩仍可能覆盖国产替代叙事。

山东黄金
01787.HK
黄金行业映射

推荐理由：Moomoo全榜中黄金行业涨9.23%、52只成分全线上涨，且贵金属与采矿涨8.39%，为A/H黄金股提供最直接隔夜映射。

触发因素：现货金与沪金保持强势，01787.HK高开后成交承接并相对恒指走强。

风险点：贵金属已处涨幅前列，若美元反弹或避险溢价回吐，高开追涨可能快速回撤。

板块轮动看板

受益方向黄金、白银与贵金属采矿、焦煤，以及港交所和高成交金融；资源链优先验证行业广度。
观察方向小米汽车与AI业务、国产算力、平台互联网，以及10年期收益率下降后的成长股承接。
压力方向计算机硬件、半导体设备与材料、电子元件、存储及GPU；韩国AI硬件拥挤交易仍在出清。
验证信号现货金/沪金与山东黄金量价、SOXX映射链、小米能否延续、00388.HK业绩缺口及10Y是否守住4.64%附近。

逻辑链

美国财政部扩大长债回购使10年期收益率降至4.64%，美股指数止跌，为A/H估值提供边际支持。
Moomoo全榜显示白银涨10.98%、黄金涨9.23%、贵金属与采矿涨8.39%，资源避险成为隔夜最强主线。
同一全榜中半导体设备与材料跌4.16%、计算机硬件跌5.16%，与SOXX下跌共同确认科技硬件压力。
A/H映射分成山东黄金等贵金属进攻，以及CPO、国产算力和港股权重的低开承接验证。
若金银价格与A/H黄金股同步放量，资源主线可延续；若贵金属冲高回落且硬件继续放量下跌，降低追涨并转向现金流防御。

风险雷达

芯片拥挤交易扩散

SOXX跌2.21%，Broadcom、AMD、设备股普遍下跌，可能压制A/H高估值硬件。

中东能源升级

阿联酋暂停对伊朗贸易与海峡袭击会推高油价、通胀和亚洲进口成本。

小米利润率反复

环比改善获价格认可，但同比利润降幅大且汽车AI新业务仍亏损。

港交所非经常收益

纪录业绩包含未上市股权估值收益，成交降温会削弱盈利持续性。

贵金属冲高回落

黄金、白银和贵金属采矿已居行业榜前列，美元反弹或避险降温会放大高开回撤。

数据来源与时间点

来源：Moomoo美股行业榜（新任务会话于2026-08-20 10:39 CST抓取，页面显示08/19 22:33 ET；完整核验145行业、98涨47跌）；Futu OpenD实时订阅的QQQ/SPY/DIA及10只panel代表股夜盘字段（行情时间约08/19 23:17 EDT，抓取于08/20 11:17 CST；无延迟标记，API未单列逐笔时间）；Futu HK/SH/SZ财报日历、NOTICE搜索及港股快照（抓取于11:15—11:17 CST）；AP关于8月19日美股收盘、美债回购、10Y收益率、KOSPI/日经、癌症疫苗、美加贸易及阿联酋—伊朗局势；小米与港交所官方业绩公告。
entries.html_en:
Major News Summary
Global
UAE suspends Iran trade as Hormuz energy tail risk rises
AP reported on Aug. 19 that the UAE suspended all trade with Iran after renewed missile fire; before the war it supplied more than 30% of Iran's imports, and several UAE tankers have been attacked in the strait over the past two weeks. The facts support oil and upstream energy while hurting shipping, airlines and long-duration growth.
Global
US and Canada move toward a deal as the 50% tariff threat eases
AP said the US and Canada moved closer to a trade agreement that could avert threatened 50% tariffs, although key terms remain unresolved. This modestly helps industrial, auto and commodity supply chains; renewed friction would still pressure export- and renminbi-sensitive assets.
Tech
Moomoo's full industry ranking shows precious metals leading and hardware lagging
The new task session retrieved all 145 industries in Moomoo's US ranking: silver rose 10.98%, gold 9.23%, coking coal 8.65%, and other precious metals and mining 8.39%, while semiconductor equipment and materials fell 4.16% and computer hardware 5.16%. A/H maps first to gold, precious metals and coking coal, while hardware still needs support after a weaker open.
Tech
Marvell jumps 9.85% as Google custom silicon reshapes ASIC competition
Marvell announced a Google partnership spanning AI inference accelerators, networking, storage and near-memory compute, plus warrants for up to 58.97 million shares. MRVL rose 9.85% while Broadcom fell 4.61%. The positive A/H read-through is high-speed interconnect, CPO and custom compute, tested by Innolight and Hygon outperforming chip benchmarks.
Tech
Korea's KOSPI drops 5.8% as Asian memory crowding is exposed
AP confirmed the KOSPI fell 5.8% and the Nikkei 225 lost 3.2%, showing that crowded AI and memory trades centered on Samsung and SK Hynix are still unwinding. A-share memory, equipment and server names should not be chased solely because US indexes bounced; overseas stabilization and institutional volume are needed.
Tech
Cancer-vaccine Phase 3 event sparks a biotech surge
Moderna and Merck reported encouraging initial melanoma-study results; Moderna soared 177% and Merck gained 12.6%. This is not an A/H earnings result, but it lifts sentiment around innovative drugs, mRNA and clinical milestones. Only A/H companies with real pipelines and disclosed data merit attention; concept chasing remains risky.
Earnings
Xiaomi extends its positive response with a roughly 3.50% gain
Xiaomi reported Q2 revenue of RMB108.92 billion, down 6.1% year over year but up 9.9% sequentially; adjusted net profit was RMB6.22 billion, down 42.6% year over year and up 2.4% quarter over quarter. At 11:17 CST, 01810.HK traded at HK$28.40 versus a HK$27.44 prior close, up about 3.50%; price continues to reward the sequential improvement, while margins still need proof.
Earnings
HKEX record results receive a mildly positive response
HKEX reported record first-half revenue and other income of HK$16.70 billion, up 19%, and attributable profit of HK$10.57 billion, up 24%. EPS was HK$8.36 and the interim dividend HK$7.43. At 11:17 CST, 00388.HK traded at HK$415.60 versus a HK$414.60 prior close, up about 0.24%; the response is positive but modest.
Earnings
Kuaishou slightly beats revenue expectations but price feedback weakens
Futu's earnings calendar shows Kuaishou Q2 revenue of RMB35.535 billion versus RMB35.490 billion expected, a slight beat, while EBIT of RMB3.757 billion was just below RMB3.804 billion expected. At 11:17 CST, 01024.HK traded at HK$33.42 versus a HK$37.80 prior close, down about 11.59%; treat it as a risk/watch item, not a long recommendation.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight indexes
Overnight indexes: three ETF proxies edge higher, with the Nasdaq proxy leading
A Futu OpenD real-time subscription snapshot at 2026-08-20 11:17 CST (about Aug. 19 23:17 EDT) showed QQQ, the Nasdaq-100 proxy, up 0.407%; SPY, the S&P 500 proxy, up 0.118%; and DIA, the Dow proxy, up 0.041%. These are overnight ETF proxies, not index futures; the source showed no delay flag and the API provided no separate per-trade timestamp.
Sector check
Sector check: gold and biotech signal potential reversals while hardware pressure diverges
Ticker-by-ticker checks found EXK +0.090%, HL +0.243% and DQ -0.071% confirming their panel direction; HYMC -0.035%, MRNA -5.476% and BTCT +113.935% signaled potential reversals. BTCT is highly idiosyncratic and does not imply a broad hardware reversal. AMR, MLAB, REFR and PASW were unavailable or had no overnight trade, so they are divergences that cannot confirm the panel. Total: three confirmations, three potential reversals and four divergences/unavailable.
A/H mapping
A/H mapping: indexes lean positive but gold breadth cools; local volume leads
Positive QQQ/SPY/DIA proxies support A/H risk appetite, but opposite overnight moves in HYMC and MRNA plus four names without trades mean the cash-session strength lacks broad confirmation. At runtime, Shandong Gold was up about 8.21%, Xiaomi about 3.50% and Kuaishou down about 11.59%. Prioritize local trading: the precious-metals mapping holds if Shandong Gold stays above its HK$25.36 open; a retreat to the HK$23.88 prior close or QQQ turning negative invalidates it.

Pre-Market Conclusion

Hardware pressure in Moomoo's cash-session industry panel is not resolved: among 10 representatives, only DQ extended the negative direction overnight; BTCT's surge is an idiosyncratic potential reversal, and four names had no trade. That is insufficient to call a broad tech-hardware reversal.All three overnight ETF proxies—QQQ, SPY and DIA—edged higher, while Shandong Gold was up about 8.21% and Xiaomi about 3.50% at runtime, supporting selective A/H risk appetite.

The panel comparison produced three confirmations, three potential reversals and four divergences/unavailable. Prioritize local A/H price and volume: precious metals need Shandong Gold to hold its HK$25.36 open, while growth needs QQQ to stay positive plus volume confirmation in CPO and domestic compute.

Kuaishou fell about 11.59% and Kingsoft about 3.83%, while Kingsoft Cloud rose about 8.01%, showing continued earnings dispersion in Hong Kong tech. Reduce offensive exposure if QQQ turns negative, Shandong Gold falls back to its HK$23.88 prior close, or MRNA's overnight reversal spreads to innovative drugs; otherwise retain selective exposure to resources and delivered earnings.

Key Stock Ideas

Xiaomi
01810.HK
Earnings positive

Why: Q2 revenue and adjusted profit improved sequentially, EV/AI/new-initiative revenue rose 17.1%, and shares gained about 6.95%.

Trigger: Holding around HK$27 and continuing to outperform HSTECH would confirm acceptance of the sequential recovery.

Risk: Revenue and adjusted profit still fell 6.1% and 42.6% year over year, while new initiatives lost RMB2.6 billion; chasing risks margin repricing.

Hong Kong Exchanges
00388.HK
Record-results test

Why: First-half revenue and profit hit records, attributable profit rose 24%, and the interim dividend increased to HK$7.43.

Trigger: A higher open that holds most of its gap on expanding volume would confirm positive feedback in Hong Kong financials.

Risk: Part of investment income reflects non-recurring valuation gains; lower market turnover could reduce earnings leverage.

Eoptolink
300308.SZ
CPO order mapping

Why: Marvell's Google deal spans AI inference, networking and storage, making high-speed interconnect a direct A-share read-through.

Trigger: A weaker open followed by lighter-volume stabilization, gap recovery and outperformance versus telecom equipment would confirm support.

Risk: SOXX, Broadcom and equipment names fell broadly; further AI-capex de-rating could overwhelm CPO.

Hygon Information
